data.long_meaning: The name Robbert is derived from the Germanic name Hrodebert, which means bright or famous. In medieval Europe, it was popular among the nobility and the clergy. The name was brought to England by the Normans in the 11th century and has since become a common English name. The name Robbert carries the meaning “Bright, famous” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin.
